summary: PMV Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 22,055,000 common shares, pre-funded warrants for 19,900,000 shares, and warrants for 41,955,000 shares, all with an exercise price of $1.21 per share. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The warrants include a contingent reset feature tied to FDA acceptance of an NDA. No special-situation category applies; the filing is an ordinary securities offering.
